description: Renovate proposes dependency updates. An ordinary update waits three days after its release (minimumReleaseAge); fixes for vulnerability alerts skip the wait by Renovate's default. timestamp-optional lets an update from a registry that reports no release date through. See https://docs.renovatebot.com/configuration-options/#minimumreleaseage

packageRules.description: faker 10 needs the tests moved to ES modules, and Vue 3 (and vue-prism-component 2, which is built for Vue 3) would break the web pages, so no major updates for these, including security pull requests (see docs/reports/2026-11-20-renovate-review.md). Minor and patch updates still come. Remove this rule once those migrations are done.
